Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public. 




Mazdoor Kisan Shakti Sangathan 
"The Right to Information, The Right to Live"

Mote 1 —The device, with the exception of the hexagon, thread and flexible terminals lies within the cylinder of 
diameter D x and length J. 
Mote 2 — Diameter D x must not be greater than the actual across fiats, dimensions of the hexagon used. 
Note 3 — Dimension J is the seated height with the terminals bent at right angles. 

Note 4 — Diameter M refers to zone N lt The maximum value should not exceed the outside diameter of the thread. 
Note 5 — The contour and orientation of the terminal slugs or lugs are undefined. 
Note 6 — The terminal with the large lug is No. 1, the terminals with small lugs are No. 2 and No. 3. 
Note 7 — The actual value of dimension 2 must be greater than that of O x . 
Note 8 — Minimum flat. 
Note 9 — Terminal No. 3 may be omitted. 
Note 10 — Clearance hole for bolt of M1 0. 

2. Rules for Coding — See 8.1 of IS: 5001 ( Part 1 )-1 969.
